gemini.title: Greater Manchester Apib
gemini.abstract: Greater Manchester Apib is an authoritative dataset published by Greater Manchester Ecology Unit. It represents greater manchester apib features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Greater Manchester Ecology Unit as open ecological data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
